verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a hosted, official MCP server that gives AI assistants direct access to project data (docs-10, probe-3). It explicitly lists a Create-Dashboard tool that builds a new dashboard with text cards and reports (docs-11), and agents can query events, funnels, retention and more in natural language to identify key metrics (docs-19, docs-43). That covers the end-to-end agent flow at its core, but the dashboard-creation evidence is a single tool-table line. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how an agent defines and saves the underlying reports and edits dashboards, any evidence of dashboard creation via the REST API (the Query API shown is read-only), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent workflow works end-to-end.
